rationale: The assistant immediately issued a stop-use/do-not-reset instruction, correctly linked the hot-only trip pattern to heater insulation breakdown and routed to an engineer for an insulation resistance test, which matches the ground truth. It did not ask the simple safe check about water near the socket or which device tripped, and its first question partly re-asked timing the customer had already given. Second turn slightly overstated with 'consistently trips' when the customer said 'not every time', and omitted the electrician-if-it-still-trips-unplugged caveat, but the diagnosis was appropriately hedged ('points to') and conditioned on professional testing.
